description: Use this when the user asks about the vote totals on a specific AAVE governance proposal — 'How did proposal #X vote?', 'Show me the for/against breakdown for proposal #185', 'Did proposal #X pass?'. Returns aggregate vote totals: total forVotes and againstVotes for the proposal. Note: individual per-voter records are not indexed in this subgraph.

proposalId.description: AAVE governance proposal ID (numeric string, e.g. '185')

name: get_proposal_votes
